title: ROKE KEHTI THI FATEMA ZEHRA
body:
roke kehti thi fatima zehra
sunlo rudaad ya habeebe quda
gham se jalta hai ab jigar mera
kya yahi ajr hai risaalat ka
<<MINI>>
lab pe ummat ka hai gila baba
qoob pursa mujhe mila baba
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ke baad mujh pe zulm huwe
mujh ko ummath ne hai diye sadme
wo masayab uthaaye hai maine
din pe padte to raat hojaate
<<MINI>>
accha hota jo mai guzar jaati
aap se pehle kaash marjaati
<<DIVIDER>>
be-sabab mere ghar pa aayi bala
kya tha mera qusoor aye baba
lakdiya leke aagaye aada
mere darwaze ko jala daala
<<MINI>>
qatm joro jafa hui mujhpar
zulm ki inteha hui mujhpar
<<DIVIDER>>
sun sako to suno meri rudaad
dhaayi ummat ne mujh pe hai bedaad
ro raha hai mera dile nashaad
haal kis se karu mai ab faryaad
<<MINI>>
aag le le ke dushman aaye hai
zulm mujh par layee’n ne dhaaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jalta darwaza jab gira mujh par
khadi dewaar se thi mai lag kar
rahem khaaya na mujh pe baa-niye shar
paaou maloon ne rakha dar par
<<MINI>>
mujh ko darwaaze se daba dala
aag se pairahan jala dala
<<DIVIDER>>
zarb mere shikam pe aisi lagi
jiski takleef bathn tak pohnchi
pehlu toota mera jafa ye hui
daro dewaar se mai dabti rahi
<<MINI>>
koi faryaad ko nahi aaya
koi imdaad ko nahi aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
shiddat-e zarb se hui eeza
dard mere shikam me hone laga
mai idhar tadpi wo udhar tadpa
margaya bathn me mera baccha
<<MINI>>
kis se faryaad mai karu bolo
ab mai kis tarah se jiyu bolo
<<DIVIDER>>
mere mohsin ko haaye wawaila
behayao'n ne qatl kar dala
besabab mujh pe zulm hai dhaaya
ab nahi koi poochne wala
<<MINI>>
mu ko ashko se dhoti rehti hu'n
apne mohsin ko roti rahti hu'n
<<DIVIDER>>
mera pursane haal koi nahi
jeene ka ab sawaal koi nahi
karne wala malaal koi nahi
zaqm ka andmaal koi nahi
<<MINI>>
jism rah rah ke sard hota hai
mere pehlu me dard hota hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shiddat-e dard ka asar ye hua
jism se toota jaan ka rishta
jaan leva tha dard ka hamla
hui bejaan fatema zehra
<<MINI>>
mujtaba karke bain rone lage
peet kar sar hussain rone lage
